messages:
Maria: kicking off preflight for asia-northeast1 GPU cluster onboarding. primary goals: artifact replication to regional registry, helm/gitops sync, network egress review, and validate node pools (A100 availability). :rocket:
Aj: thanks — checklist idea: 1) mirror images to asia-northeast1-registry, 2) sign images and update image manifests, 3) create gitops PR for helm values, 4) smoke deploy on a small nodepool, 5) run perf/cost sanity tests.
Dylan: note — the region only has limited A100 capacity. we should have fallback to v100+half-precision quant models if A100 quota delayed. add routing policy in rollout.
Sophia: for the registry mirror we'll use the replica cache cluster (replica service) + signed manifests. I'll kick replication but need the list of image tags. Maria: sending list now.
Maria: images: 
```
redwood-inference/runtime:prod-2026.03.10
redwood-inference/quant-kernels:qp4-v2
redwood-inference/launcher:1.9.2
```
Kevin: helm values we change: `image.repository`, `image.tag`, `imagePullSecrets`, and `nodeSelector.gpuType`. I'll prepare a values override and open the gitops PR.
Aj: also add artifact retention policy in the registry to avoid long-term cost blowup. propose 7d hot cache for recent tags + cold storage for older artifacts.
Sophia: good call. estimated warmup egress ~1.6TB to mirror current image set. infra-bot do we have egress budget for asia-northeast1 this month?
infra-bot: Budget check: asia-northeast1 egress remaining = 4.3TB this billing cycle.
Dylan: that should be enough, but let's throttle replication to avoid saturating cross-region links. use `--bandwidth-limit 50MB/s` on the mirroring job.
registry-bot: replication job queued -> job_id=rep-20260315-22, target=asia-northeast1-registry, objects=142, estimated_time=11h (with bandwidth limit).
Maria: when the registry-bot finishes, we need imagePullSecrets rotation plan for customer clusters. Kevin, annotate PR with secret name and KMS key.
Kevin: will do. also adding helm post-install hook to validate node GPU type, fail fast if no A100 nodes. snippet: 
```
# values-asia-northeast1.yaml
image:
  repository: asia-northeast1-registry.gcr.io/redwood-inference/runtime
  tag: prod-2026.03.10
nodeSelector:
  gpu: a100
```
Sophia: network note — CNI in this region has MTU 1460; large model shards can hit fragmentation for RPC, enable `gRPC keepalive` and bump timeouts in the runtime config.
Aj: ops checklist before handoff: reproduce health-check smoke test (generate 100 short inferences), validate KV cache hits, confirm autoscaler works with min=2 max=20, run cost sim with Optimize tool.
Maria: I'll schedule a 30m handoff with platform team tomorrow 10am PT. Kevin + Dylan + Sophia please attend.
Dylan: quick question — do we also replicate private customer models to the region now or wait until customer approves? replication could expose additional egress/permissions work.
Maria: hold customer models until signed LOA. public images only for initial boot.
Sophia: after registry warmup I'll trigger a canary rollout to a single availability zone, monitor latency and token costs for 6h. if stable, promote.
infra-bot: canary deployment launched: canary-id=cnry-asia-northeast1-01, pods=3 (gpu:a100), start_ts=1938207825.
Kevin: gitops PR opened -> https://git.example.com/redwood/gitops/merge_requests/312 : includes values override + post-install validations.
Aj: sounds good. Maria — please paste the final replication job id and handoff agenda once you have them. :thumbsup:
Maria: will do. final notes: keep replication window off-peak (23:00-07:00 local), enable bandwidth cap, and tag all mirrored images with `region-asia-ne` prefix for traceability. спасибо.
